text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zambia is to benefit from a World Bank programme which awards 80 percent debt relief to countries that adhere to stringent structural adustment programmes, finance minister Ronald Penza said.
- Tanzanian president Benjamin Mpaka has commended Zambia for imposing sanctions against war-torn Burundi.

- Trade between Zambia and neighbouring Zimbabwe is grossly unbalanced largely because Zambia has removed trade barriers while Zimbabwe has not, chairman of the confederation of chambers of commerce and industry George Chabwera said.
- Energy minister Edith Nawaki lied about a fuel shortage in Zambia, which she attributed to maintenance problems at port Dar-es-Salaam in Tanzania, opposition leaders and diplomatic sources said.
